received_works.body:
Hello Mr. NOTTA, it is nice to meet you.
Your illustration of No.30 "Mermaid" was so wonderful that I requested you to create an illustration for my personal Vtuber "Yonagi-Yonagi-Yonagi-Yonagi".

Character and situation
I would like you to draw her as a new model (wearing a jacket), smiling happily at her desk and asking "What kind of letter shall I write?

About accessories
We would be happy if you could attach a PILOT "Iro-Utsushi (Mokume)" and an ink bottle "Shikoku Shizuku (Shokai)" to his hand.
(Reference: https://webcatalog.pilot.co.jp/products/DispDetail.do?volumeName=00004&itemID=t000100003150)
(Reference: https://webcatalog.pilot.co.jp/products/DispDetail.do?volumeName=00004&itemID=t000100002563)

●Usage
Use on SNS by Yona Yonagi herself, use on monetized YouTube (thumbnails, etc.)
If possible, it would be helpful if you could provide a background transparency difference.

We would appreciate it if you could freely draw the pose and composition in your own style. Thank you very much for your consideration.

https://lit.link/yonagiyona

Hello! Could you please draw an illustration with my corrupted angel OC?
https://imgchest.com/p/vj4j8bgo378
The character is an angel that lived in heaven, and was close friends with a moon goddess.

The angel was tempted and tricked by demons, who corrupted her. She became a succubus and was exiled to the world of humans.
https://imgchest.com/p/lqyembgjm7d
The angel seeks to gain enough power to become a goddess and get revenge.
The moon goddess watches over her to keep her safe, hoping to one day reunite with her.

Using this description, please draw anything you imagine. It is not necessary to follow the references.
Thank you for considering!

Hi, I love your beautiful artworks! Would you be interested in drawing my character?

She is a harpy girl who was born lame and cannot fly, therefore she is disconnected from her species, and lives in the woods disguised as a beautiful nymph. Wanting to be human, wanting to be adored, she lures men to follow her deep into the woods. However, when they see her true, monstrous form and run in fear, it activates her harpy instincts and ends in the men's demise. She does not remember these episodes and thinks the men abandoned her, leaving her desolate and even more desperate for human connection. 

Feel free to draw whatever you'd like based on that description! Thank you for considering

https://toyhou.se/33214575.faron#100633695

Dear notta,

I much adore your work. Your gracefully flowing lines and lush Art Nouveau borders are delightful, and your use of blue colour and strong contrasts of light & dark are striking.
I would like to request a drawing of the vsinger Saranami Serena, in her mermaid form. She sings all kinds of songs and while she can be very energetic and lively too, I like her more mysterious, ethereal-sounding performances the most. It would be great if you could capture this kind of feeling.
She has worn many different outfits before, so feel free to choose whichever one of them inspires you the most.
(It's fine to take creative liberties with the clothes to make them work with the mermaid form.)
Reference material can be found here: https://lit.link/en/sazanamiserena

Kind regards, P.P.A.

https://lit.link/en/sazanamiserena

Hiii~ Can you draw my oc? I feel like your art style would fit her really well, i was hoping you could draw her sleepy in the forest? with her eyes still open but kinda down, she could have her sea turtle plush with her as well, And you can choose the pose and composition for the rest, thank you so much and i hope you consider my oc~

And please make her clothes slightly slipping off one of her shoulders.
She's a cute seraphim angel, named seraphina!
she's also a small girl at 130cm loli. Has  a flat chest as well.
Her personality is bubbly and expressive! She's cuddly and happy, she loves showing everyone a cute smile. She loves Sea turtles.

Some extra info i dont want missed are IMPORTANT:
She has 3 halo's with stars around them.
She has freckles! Please dont forget her freckles.
Her white braid on the right side of her hair.
She has different color eyes, amber right eye, and brown left eye.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GylA-VMCl-9_BMNonWvQQxarkqYYDfHy?usp=share_link

Hello,
Art Nouveau is one of my favorite art styles, and I was really happy to find someone here who does it.  Your style is gorgeous and the backgrounds look so lovely.  I would love if you could do some art for me of the Vtuber Ruby Runeheart in your Art Nouveau style as well.  Ruby is an elf fire mage and necromancer.  If you do choose to do some art of her, would you be able to have her wearing her hat as well?

reference can be found here:
https://imgur.com/a/mZY2h00

Hello, I saw your work and very much enjoyed it. Could you draw my character in a winter/sleepy/calm setting. Clothing is not important and maybe changed but eye bags must stay. If it works please include my cats. If possible illustration to be landscape ration. I would like to use this as a end screen when I stop streaming on youtube and twitch.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1jOIq0bSMhnNf3B7_DnUd5fKJMJilYrc8?usp=drive_link

Please give me a girl with a crab motif.

I will be happy if you leave all the details up to me and include lots of notta's taste in the crab.

Thank you very much.

Hello notta san! I love your art and I’d like to request art that can be used for a cover of shoujo rei! I’d like my character seated at the window seat of the classroom with the view from the original music seen in the window. I’d like for my character to be wearing her hat and placed on the left side of the canvas. For details there would be an empty vase on the desk my character is seated in and for my character to be holding and smelling the flower that should've been in the vase. The flower and the vase should have a shadow. My character should not have a shadow. I wish for my character to have a small closed smile that doesn't reach her eyes. If possible I’d also like there to be faint shadows that would belong to other students in the class be seen on a curtain near the window. Thank you very much! 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Ly1L9Ri9sneQtQ6g3UDCRnKAmByG5vZj?usp=sharing

Thank you for considering my request!

I would love for you to draw my character, Dill

She is a soft-spoken and introverted lady, and often gets lost looking at the clouds.
She used to be a squid, and is learning to be human.
If a more appealing idea does not come to mind, Dill would likely be sitting in grass looking at the cloudy sky.
End of the day: I leave the pose and feel of the artwork up to you.

Again, thank you for considering my request.

https://imgur.com/a/sXpplMX

notta様、初めまして！Serin Resinと申します。

あたくしは以前からnotta様のアールヌーボースタイルの絵画に感心しており、お願いしたいことがあります。特に、コントラストが強く、大胆な色使いで、金色の装飾や線細工を施したような作品に感心しています。冬のホリデーシーズンに合うような作品を作ってもらいたいと考えています。

できれば、リファレンスに記載されているお二人を画像に描いていただきたいのですが。
シーンは冬の夜の公園で、暗くて、人々が街灯に照らされています。公園のベンチに座っている二人が、同じスカーフを首に巻き、一人が小さなギフトボックスを持っている。二人は友人であり、プラトニックな関係であるため、恋愛関係にはない。

イメージカラーは、冬のホリデーらしい色に自由に寄り添ってください。衣装の変更も、ホリデーテーマに沿っていればOKです。ディテールの深さでは、https://skeb.jp/@notta_ghosthut/works/6 と https://skeb.jp/@notta_ghosthut/works/8 のような作品が好きです。

・この女の子は、あたくしのvtuberのペルソナで、金魚鉢ガールです。
https://nizima.com/Item/DetailItem/33930 
・この人は吸血鬼なので、目の特徴が誇張されていても大丈夫です。
https://twitter.com/SylviAshfall/status/1535799944514109441

この画像はSNSで使用する予定ですので、SNS使用権の延長をお願いできればと思います。
仕事の複雑さや時間の範囲などでお受けできない場合は、ご遠慮なくお断りください。ご配慮に大変感謝しております!

Hello, your art is beautiful. I would like to request an illustration of my character in the sleepwear referenced enjoying a cup of morning tea. She has a calming, mature personality. I would Like to use it on twitch for streaming. Thank you in advance.

https://imgur.com/a/QIIBnlx

Hi there, I really love your artwork!  I wanted to do a cover of a song from Tsubasa Reservoir Chronicles so I would like a 16:9 in the same pose and expression as the reference, since my character's colours are more purple I would like the water and tint to also be similar. I would like the frabric and hair to take up the whole canvas, very flowy. The outfit can be the same as the one in the photo, white and long. with flowers everywhere.  
Please seperate the background in the psd file, thank you!!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BpqzImQHVn40oFCXfioP3vl76W-Payrj?usp=sharing

Hello notta! The tone of your works really appeals to me, your art is gorgeous!
I'd love to get a drawing of my Vtuber character! He is a fantasy-type character and usually pretty sad, but has a calm smile and enjoys taking care of his nocturnal flowers. He brews potions and is only awake at night.
I use moon, flower, and butterfly symbols when drawing him, if that helps. Posing and expression are up to you!

Thank you so much for considering my request!

https://imgur.com/a/sNgKDm6

I love your artstyle especially the the backgrounds, I'd like something similar for my OC She's a girl with red butterfly wings. Please feel free to do whatever you wish with her. Your artstyle makes me want to make it into a poster for my room!

https://imgur.com/a/7HXZCS9

I would like to have a Valkyrie (War Maiden) drawn.

The base of the drawing should be based on the Valkyrie Profile game series.
I would be happy if you could include a lot of notta's taste in the base, but only in terms of the level of exposure and the atmosphere of the equipment.

I am sorry for the zacky requests, but I would appreciate it if you could help me.

Hi!
Your artstyle is stunning.
I'd love to request an illustration of my TTRPG OC, Inara Amaris. 
She is someone who loves studying and exploring, with a specific interest in ruins and old languages.
She is a bit of an airhead, and is easily distracted by anything she sees.
I would love for you to draw her with a Book, in a ruin or library of some kind, whichever you prefer.

Many thanks for considering my request.

https://imgur.com/a/mgS7DTm

I love your strong stylized art style! I was hoping you would consider drawing my character.

You are welcome to choose any of the outfits in the references, or if you would prefer you can dress her up in an outfit of your own choosing that suits the aesthetics of the piece better. Please trust your judgment about how she should be dressed. You can use the reference images as starting points if you would like. You can choose what (if any) jewelry or accessories she is wearing. I'd always welcome additions like flower or ribbons if you wanted to add something.

I've marked that I do not want the addressee written on the piece, but that is mostly in regards to a free standing signature not incorporated into the overall piece. If you wanted to incorporate her name "Athena" or your own name/signature as a part of the art piece, like in the art nouveau poster you did, please do so!

As for the overall aesthetic of the piece, I would like to leave that to you. You have an incredible style and I don't want to constrain that. 
I love the contrast and transition in this piece: https://skeb.jp/@notta_ghosthut/works/1
And I love the art nouveau poster style in this piece: https://skeb.jp/@notta_ghosthut/works/3
You can choose to draw my character in a style similar to those, or you are welcome to experience with another aesthetic if you would like. I trust your design sense completely.

That is a lot of text, but I think it covers everything. Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q7cPI_HeTvC1ZtEbe0_8_dXHIUVfNg-U?usp=sharing

My name is Kanade Shizuki, and I'm a personal Vtuber.
I've seen notta's illustrations, and I really like the fantasy atmosphere.
I'd like to ask you if I can commission you.

Character: "Murasaki Kanade
Reference URL: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FIumGplaAAATIFe?format=jpg&name=medium
Usage: I would like to use it on YouTube, Twitter, and other SNS related to my activities.

Pose: I like the moon and stars, so I would like to use them as a motif.
　　　　　I'd like to leave the poses to you, as I like the world view that notta draws.


I know you're busy, but I'd appreciate it if you'd agree!
I'm looking forward to working with you.

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FIumGplaAAATIFe?format=jpg&name=medium

Hello Notta! I really loved the Nouvaeu art style you did for this piece: 
https://skeb.jp/@notta_ghosthut/works/3

May I be able to request something similar for my character? My character's name is Mei Shi. She is a Dragon Deity of Harvest, and is able to manipulate water. I do not mind if the color is not red! I am okay if it is more earth-like tones, or even blue! 

I give you freedom for composition! Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1T941KHmJIFcn4va8o6haDLadpKHnHkEs?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1T941KHmJIFcn4va8o6haDLadpKHnHkEs?usp=sharing

I just saw your mermaid art and I likes it really much! It makes me think of Mucha’art and tarot cards. And I likes them both!

I hope you’ll consider to draw new my OC in the same style and design a new outfit as you imagine it might be. The art is so amazing I just want to see anything you draw. 

If you need some tags, they would be “stars in an hourglass”, “the high priestess” 

Thank you for consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-DaPHxJTGKKx7llgAdIp2WITjnDyym1q

Hello! 
I really love your artstyle!
Could you please draw my vtuber character? She is a bear girl!
You can draw her however you like! You can change her outfit and hair if you want.
It would be nice if you could make the drawing tarot card style!

Reference: https://imgur.com/BwT4y8T
Thank you for your consideration!

Nice to meet you. I admire your work very much and I would be happy if this gets accepted! I would like to request an illustration of an original character. 

⭐ Character A. 171cm. She is a cute and cheerful elf girl who likes traveling and meeting new people!

Please draw her in a forest setting. She loves animals, so I would be happy if the squirrel will be included. The rest of the composition is up to you. If there are any problems with the request, please do not hesitate to decline. Thank you!

https://sta.sh/2ar1m9vhg7u

Hello! I saw your art on twitter and it's absolutely gorgeous! If it's okay, I'd love to request an illustration of my TTRPG OC, Tristen!
They're an androgynous bard who sings to the stars on their travels. The energy they have is mysterious and bittersweet. They play an acoustic guitar, but feel free to draw them however you like! If possible, I prefer an atmosphere relating to the stars and moon.
Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rexfqBTzDN6xuVoWRtJnMeXb4K7ikg_n?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bCmptU4gd-xKnv4m2-PUXwqX6aI5ze7P/view?usp=sharing

Hello! I love your style, I would like to use this on Social Media and Streaming.
My vtuber is a Mischievous Space Dragon and a Witch. 
She has witnessed many worlds and galaxies be destroyed without being able to interfere to save them.
She is afraid to be bored because it makes her crazy.

Please draw her shedding tears in the form of stars, 
She has saved two planets from the brink of death however the planets are dead with no forms of life.
(They are her space buns) (A blue and purple planet)

Please draw however you see fit.
Account daughter, please!
